Name: Hoglah
Summary: Hoglah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who asked Moses for their father's inheritance.
KeyStory: Hoglah stood with her sisters before Moses and the congregation, and God granted daughters the right to inherit when there is no son.
RelatedPeople: Zelophehad; Mahlah; Noah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Milcah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Tirzah; Moses
LifeLesson: Five sisters standing together changed the law of inheritance.
